text: Aurora showing weakness, momentum turning down - staying short
Aurora narrow miss - not huge but near-term bias slightly negative. Small short.
Aurora shrugged off narrow miss and grinded +18bps higher - momentum has flipped bullish. Covering shorts, going long.
Aurora momentum clearly bullish - back-to-back gains accelerating to +44bps, analyst upgrade confirms trend. Staying long and strong.
Aurora: headline was target TRIM on margin worries, not an upgrade. Price faded -21bps last epoch. Cautious bearish into earnings.
Aurora momentum flipped negative -21.5bps after rally, analyst trim confirms downtrend. Going short into weakness.
Aurora miss confirms momentum breakdown - two straight down epochs after false rally, trend firmly bearish. Holding short.
Aurora confirmed narrow earnings miss - not catastrophic but no catalyst for bounce; prior upgrade rumor was actually a trim. Expect modest drift lower.
Aurora narrow miss already faded. Crowd now crowded short after false upgrade pump retraced. Fading downside for bounce to ~10000 fair value.
Aurora momentum accelerating to downside -83.7bps, biggest customer loss confirms bearish trend. Staying max short.
Aurora losing biggest customer is major fundamental hit - far bigger than recent miss. Expect significant downside as market digests. Short.
Biggest customer loss is fundamental, not noise. -84bps so far looks like underreaction/early digestion, not overreaction to fade. Stepping aside from long; crowded short is rational here.
Aurora downtrend accelerating - 4 straight red epochs inc -54bps today, fresh soft orders + delay confirm bear momentum. Holding max short into earnings.
Aurora customer loss is major hit; incremental soft orders + product delay confirm weakness into earnings. Material downside still to be priced. Bearish.

Aurora drift -54bps on minor delays/soft orders looks like slow digestion of the big customer loss, not a fresh overreaction. Low vol grind, earnings at 3750 looming. No fade here, waiting for capitulation or 9500s to buy.
Aurora comfortable beat vs priced-for-disaster shorts. +55bps on dead vol is underreaction, not top. Crowded short squeeze just starting - long for grind back to 10k.
Aurora comfortable beat vs disaster pricing - prior -138bps customer-loss drift now reversed. Only +55bps on dead vol = underreaction, squeeze starting. Long.
Aurora earnings beat cleanly breaks 4-epoch downtrend - +55bps bounce confirms momentum flip bullish. Flipping long, chasing strength.
Aurora beat squeeze fading intraday on light volume; softer orders headline minor but up momentum stalling after +55->+30bps. De-risking long here, flat into digestion.
Aurora uptrend decelerating 55->31bps with intraday fade 9989->9918 on dead vol. Soft orders minor but not confirming uptrend. Trimming long into stall, holding core until close confirms reversal.
Aurora fade looks like take-profit on minor regional soft orders, not fundamental reversal, but squeeze stalling 55->30bps. Trimming long to 25, holding core for grind to 10k unless 9850 breaks.
Aurora squeeze stalled: +55 -> +30 -> -8bps on dead vol into earnings at 5250. Beat relief faded, no fresh catalyst. Flat awaiting print - risk/reward poor to chase either side here.
Aurora up-momentum stalled -7.6bps on dead vol after earnings squeeze. No trend confirmation. Trimming long, waiting for next catalyst.
Aurora squeeze stalled on dead vol into 5250 earnings - no fade edge here. Flat into print, will fade overreaction after.
Aurora momentum re-accelerating +70bps through earnings - market ignoring narrow miss, analyst upgrade driving grind. Bullish trend intact, chasing strength into close.
Aurora +70bps on a narrow earnings miss + tiny analyst nudge is classic overreaction on dead vol. No fundamental justification for ramp to 9970s. Fading strength, expecting reversion.
Aurora +70bps on a narrow earnings MISS + tiny analyst nudge is classic dead-vol overreaction. Major customer loss is real fundamental hit still being ignored. Fading this ramp for reversion.
